name: Air-Walker

abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): İki tehlike: karanlık gelgit hasarı ve yoğun güç kazanımı. Nötralize ederek kozmik gücünü kaldır veya güç kontrolcüleri kullan. Zırh-kırmaya immün veya purify eden şampiyonlar da iyi.
signatureAbility:
Herald of The Destroyer
Inflict a Dark Tide Debuff on the opponent every [20 - 8] second(s).

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Offensive Combat Power Rate is decreased by 40%.

abilitySections.title: Power Cosmic - Persistent Buff - Max 3
content: Gain 3.5% of a Bar of Power every 1 second(s).
+[964.29] Armor Rating.
+[450.45] Attack Rating.
Air-Walker starts the quest with 1 Power Cosmic Buff(s), which persists between fights. He gains 1 Power Cosmic Buff(s) when he wins a fight.
When Air-Walker has no Power Cosmic Buffs, he will gain one after a 7.5 second cooldown.
Special Attack 3 can only be used if Air-Walker has 3 Power Cosmic Buffs or is Defending.

abilitySections.title: When Power Drained, Power Locked, or Power Burned
content: Inflict 3 Dark Tide Debuffs.

abilitySections.title: The Dark Tide - Debuff - Max 10
content: Dark Tide Debuffs reduce Block Proficiency by [93.75] during their Opponent's Special Attacks, and last indefinitely.
Champions suffering from both Armor Break and Dark Tide take Direct Damage every 0.50 second(s). This damage is equal to 2% of their Opponent's Base Attack per Dark Tide.
Opponents remove one Dark Tide Debuff every time they fill a Bar of Power, or whenever the Power Cosmic is Nullified.

abilitySections.title: The Dark Tide - Passive - Cross Fight - Max 1
content: When the Opponent has 10 Dark Tide Debuffs, they are combined into a Passive that lasts for the rest of the fight and the next 2 fights they participate in.
The Dark Tide Passive counts as 10 Dark Tide Debuffs for Air-Walker's abilities, and also gains additional effects based on the Opponent's Class.
If the Opponent has a Dark Tide Passive, Air-Walker's fourth Light Hit refreshes 2 Armor Break Debuff(s) on them.

abilitySections.title: When Charging a Heavy Attack
content: Increase Ability Power Rate by 300% and Heavy Charging can be held for an extended duration.
75% of any Power Gained while Charging is lost over 0.75 second(s) after the Charge stops.
If Air-Walker fills a Bar of Power, he gains an Unblockable Buff for 1 second(s) that is paused during his Special Attacks.
If Air-Walker activates a Special Attack, he gains a Fury Buff during that Special Attack, increasing Attack Rating by +[3,003].

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Activating a Special Attack Armor Breaks the Opponent, reducing Armor Rating by [2,250] for 11 second(s), stacking up to 8 time(s).
If the last hit isn't Blocked, apply 1 Dark Tide Debuff to the Opponent, and an additional one for each Buff on Air-Walker.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The last hit has a 50% chance to inflict a Stun Debuff for 2 second(s). The chance is increased by 50% flat if Air-Walker is Unblockable.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: If the Opponent has a Dark Tide Passive, this attack deals an additional 45% of the damage dealt as a burst of Energy Damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Air-Walker replaces Power Cosmic with the Power of Galactus Buff for 20 second(s), granting:
+[4,504.5] Attack Rating.
Regenerate +[8,504.4] Health.
Gain 10.5% of a Bar of Power every 1 second(s).
Gain a Passive Unstoppable effect.
Every attack has a 100% chance to deal an additional burst of Direct Damage. The damage is equal to 5.5% of the damage dealt, per Dark Tide on the Opponent.
Power of Galactus sets Air-Walker's Power to 0 when it ends.

abilitySections.title: The Dark Tide - Cross Fight Class Effects
content: Tech: Reduces the duration and potency of Power Drain, Lock and Burn effects by 70%.
Mutant: Reduces Offensive Ability Accuracy during Special Attacks by 33%.
Skill: Critical Rating is reduced by [634.62].
Science: Non-Damaging Debuffs have -25% Ability Accuracy.
Cosmic: Buffs potency is reduced by 50%.
Mystic: Mystical energies resist the Dark Tide, so it has no additional effect.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Herald of The Destroyer
content: Inflict a Dark Tide Debuff on the opponent every [20 - 8] second(s).
